CRM_Audiencias_Vol_Load.queryText:

CRM_Email_Detalle_Load.name: CRM_Email_Detalle_Load
CRM_Email_Detalle_Load.queryText:
/*  CRM_Email_Detalle — mantenida por Hive
    Grano: 1 renglon por JobID x dia de ENVIO. Solo las piezas activas del catalogo.
    Ventana: eventos desde 2026-03-01.  Update type: Update (upsert por RowKey).

    ATRIBUCION: las aperturas/clicks/rebotes se cuentan en el dia en que SALIO el
    correo, no en el dia del evento. Por eso cada evento se une de vuelta a _Sent por
    JobID+ListID+BatchID+SubscriberID y hereda SU fecha. Sin esto aparecen dias con
    aperturas y cero envios, y Delivered sale negativo.

    RTRIM en el join: SFMC rellena _Job.EmailName a 100 chars con espacios; el
    catalogo trae el nombre limpio. Sin RTRIM no matchea NADA.                      */

SELECT
    m.RowKey                                    AS RowKey,
    m.JobID                                     AS JobID,
    m.SendDay                                   AS SendDay,
    MAX(c.ConfigKey)                            AS ConfigKey,
    MAX(c.BU)                                   AS BU,
    MAX(c.Marca)                                AS Marca,
    MAX(c.Campana)                              AS Campana,
    MAX(c.Touchpoint)                           AS Touchpoint,
    MAX(c.Segmento)                             AS Segmento,
    MAX(RTRIM(j.EmailName))                     AS EmailName,
    MAX(RTRIM(j.EmailSubject))                  AS Email_Subject,
    MAX(RTRIM(j.FromName))                      AS Email_Sender_Name,
    m.SendDay                                   AS Send_Date,
    MAX(RTRIM(jr.JourneyName))                  AS Journey_Name,
    MAX(jr.JourneyID)                           AS Journey_UUID,
    MAX(c.CodigoNC)                             AS Codigo_NC,
    MAX(au.Audience_DE)                          AS Audience_DE,
    MAX(au.Audience_Volume)                     AS Audience_Volume,

    /*  Email_ID = identidad del CREATIVO en SFMC. Sobrevive a los renombres, asi que
        delata cuando dos ConfigKey distintos apuntan al mismo correo. NO es llave: el
        mismo creativo se reusa entre campanas y meses. La llave sigue siendo el JobID. */
    MAX(j.EmailID)                              AS Email_ID,

    /*  Es_FUP segun el NOMBRE en SFMC, no segun el catalogo: asi se puede contrastar
        contra Touchpoint y ver donde no coinciden.                                     */
    MAX(CASE WHEN RTRIM(j.EmailName) LIKE '%FUP%'
               OR RTRIM(j.EmailName) LIKE '%-FP[_ -]%'
               OR RTRIM(j.EmailName) LIKE '%-FP'
             THEN 'Si' ELSE 'No' END)           AS Es_FUP,

    /*  El numero final del Content Name = el ID de journey que usa Datorama
        (803867 = AON marzo, 863587 = AON abril). Es el que permite cruzar.             */
    MAX(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('_', REVERSE(RTRIM(j.EmailName))) BETWEEN 2 AND 9
               AND ISNUMERIC(RIGHT(RTRIM(j.EmailName),
                     CHARINDEX('_', REVERSE(RTRIM(j.EmailName))) - 1)) = 1
             THEN RIGHT(RTRIM(j.EmailName),
                     CHARINDEX('_', REVERSE(RTRIM(j.EmailName))) - 1)
             ELSE NULL END)                     AS Journey_ID_Datorama,
    MAX(m.Sends)                                AS Email_Sends,
    CASE WHEN MAX(m.Sends) - MAX(m.Bounces) < 0 THEN 0
         ELSE MAX(m.Sends) - MAX(m.Bounces) END AS Email_Deliveries,
    MAX(m.Bounces)                              AS Email_Bounces,
    MAX(m.BouncesSoft)                          AS Email_Bounces_Soft,
    MAX(m.UOpens)                               AS Email_Unique_Opens,
    MAX(m.TOpens)                               AS Email_Total_Opens,
    MAX(m.UClicks)                              AS Email_Unique_Clicks,
    MAX(m.TClicks)                              AS Email_Total_Clicks,
    MAX(m.Unsubs)                               AS Email_Total_Unsubs,
    MAX(m.UUnsubs)                              AS Email_Unique_Unsubs,
    CASE WHEN MAX(m.Sends) = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE CONVERT(decimal(6,2), 100.0 * (MAX(m.Sends) - MAX(m.Bounces)) / MAX(m.Sends)) END AS Delivery_Rate,
    CASE WHEN MAX(m.Sends) - MAX(m.Bounces) <= 0 THEN 0
         ELSE CONVERT(decimal(6,2), 100.0 * MAX(m.UOpens) / (MAX(m.Sends) - MAX(m.Bounces))) END AS Open_Rate,
    CASE WHEN MAX(m.Sends) - MAX(m.Bounces) <= 0 THEN 0
         ELSE CONVERT(decimal(6,2), 100.0 * MAX(m.UClicks) / (MAX(m.Sends) - MAX(m.Bounces))) END AS Click_Rate,
    CASE WHEN MAX(m.UOpens) = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE CONVERT(decimal(6,2), 100.0 * MAX(m.UClicks) / MAX(m.UOpens)) END AS CTOR,
    CASE WHEN MAX(m.Sends) = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE CONVERT(decimal(6,2), 100.0 * MAX(m.Bounces) / MAX(m.Sends)) END AS Bounce_Rate,
    GETDATE()                                   AS LastRefresh
FROM (
    SELECT
        CONVERT(varchar(20), x.JobID) + '_' + CONVERT(varchar(8), x.SendDay, 112) AS RowKey,
        x.JobID              AS JobID,
        x.SendDay            AS SendDay,
        SUM(x.Sends)         AS Sends,
        SUM(x.Bounces)       AS Bounces,
        SUM(x.BouncesSoft)   AS BouncesSoft,
        SUM(x.UOpens)        AS UOpens,
        SUM(x.TOpens)        AS TOpens,
        SUM(x.UClicks)       AS UClicks,
        SUM(x.TClicks)       AS TClicks,
        SUM(x.Unsubs)        AS Unsubs,
        SUM(x.UUnsubs)       AS UUnsubs
    FROM (
            SELECT JobID, CONVERT(date, EventDate) AS SendDay,
                   COUNT(*) AS Sends, 0 AS Bounces, 0 AS BouncesSoft,
                   0 AS UOpens, 0 AS TOpens, 0 AS UClicks, 0 AS TClicks, 0 AS Unsubs, 0 AS UUnsubs
            FROM _Sent
            WHERE EventDate >= '2026-03-01'
            GROUP BY JobID, CONVERT(date, EventDate)
        UNION ALL
            SELECT s.JobID, CONVERT(date, s.EventDate),
                   0, COUNT(*),
                   SUM(CASE WHEN b.BounceCategory LIKE 'Soft%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
                   0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
            FROM _Bounce b
            JOIN _Sent s ON s.JobID = b.JobID AND s.ListID = b.ListID
                        AND s.BatchID = b.BatchID AND s.SubscriberID = b.SubscriberID
            WHERE s.EventDate >= '2026-03-01'
            GROUP BY s.JobID, CONVERT(date, s.EventDate)
        UNION ALL
            SELECT s.JobID, CONVERT(date, s.EventDate),
                   0, 0, 0,
                   SUM(CASE WHEN o.IsUnique = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(*),
                   0, 0, 0, 0
            FROM _Open o
            JOIN _Sent s ON s.JobID = o.JobID AND s.ListID = o.ListID
                        AND s.BatchID = o.BatchID AND s.SubscriberID = o.SubscriberID
            WHERE s.EventDate >= '2026-03-01'
            GROUP BY s.JobID, CONVERT(date, s.EventDate)
        UNION ALL
            SELECT s.JobID, CONVERT(date, s.EventDate),
                   0, 0, 0, 0, 0,
                   SUM(CASE WHEN k.IsUnique = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(*),
                   0, 0
            FROM _Click k
            JOIN _Sent s ON s.JobID = k.JobID AND s.ListID = k.ListID
                        AND s.BatchID = k.BatchID AND s.SubscriberID = k.SubscriberID
            WHERE s.EventDate >= '2026-03-01'
            GROUP BY s.JobID, CONVERT(date, s.EventDate)
        UNION ALL
            SELECT s.JobID, CONVERT(date, s.EventDate),
                   0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0,
                   COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT u.SubscriberID)
            FROM _Unsubscribe u
            JOIN _Sent s ON s.JobID = u.JobID AND s.ListID = u.ListID
                        AND s.BatchID = u.BatchID AND s.SubscriberID = u.SubscriberID
            WHERE s.EventDate >= '2026-03-01'
            GROUP BY s.JobID, CONVERT(date, s.EventDate)
    ) x
    GROUP BY x.JobID, x.SendDay
) m
INNER JOIN _Job j
        ON j.JobID = m.JobID
INNER JOIN CRM_Reporte_Config c
        ON RTRIM(j.EmailName) = c.EmailName
       AND c.Activo = 'Si'
       LEFT  JOIN CRM_Audiencias au ON au.ConfigKey = c.ConfigKey
LEFT  JOIN _JourneyActivity ja
        ON ja.JourneyActivityObjectID = j.TriggererSendDefinitionObjectID
LEFT  JOIN _Journey jr
        ON jr.VersionID = ja.VersionID
GROUP BY m.RowKey, m.JobID, m.SendDay

CRM_Email_Links_Load.name: CRM_Email_Links_Load
CRM_Email_Links_Load.queryText:
/*  CRM_Email_Links — clicks por link/boton por pieza, filtrado por catalogo.
    Link_Name: el nombre del boton en SFMC; si viene vacio (57% de los links no traen
    LinkName), se deriva del destino (dominio + ruta). Link_URL: destino limpio (sin AMPscript). */
SELECT
    LEFT(c.ConfigKey + '|' + RTRIM(k.URL), 400)  AS RowKey,
    MAX(c.ConfigKey)                             AS ConfigKey,
    MAX(c.Campana)                               AS Campana,
    MAX(c.Touchpoint)                            AS Touchpoint,
    MAX(c.Segmento)                              AS Segmento,
    MAX(RTRIM(j.EmailName))                      AS EmailName,
    MAX(RTRIM(j.EmailSubject))                   AS Email_Subject,
    MAX(j.EmailID)                               AS Email_ID,
    CASE WHEN MAX(RTRIM(k.LinkName)) <> '' THEN MAX(RTRIM(k.LinkName))
         ELSE LEFT(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(
        CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('?', MAX(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('http', RTRIM(k.URL)) > 0
        THEN SUBSTRING(RTRIM(k.URL),
               CHARINDEX('http', RTRIM(k.URL)),
               CHARINDEX('''', RTRIM(k.URL) + '''', CHARINDEX('http', RTRIM(k.URL)))
                 - CHARINDEX('http', RTRIM(k.URL)))
        ELSE RTRIM(k.URL) END)) > 0
             THEN LEFT(MAX(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('http', RTRIM(k.URL)) > 0
        THEN SUBSTRING(RTRIM(k.URL),
               CHARINDEX('http', RTRIM(k.URL)),
               CHARINDEX('''', RTRIM(k.URL) + '''', CHARINDEX('http', RTRIM(k.URL)))
                 - CHARINDEX('http', RTRIM(k.URL)))
        ELSE RTRIM(k.URL) END), CHARINDEX('?', MAX(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('http', RTRIM(k.URL)) > 0
        THEN SUBSTRING(RTRIM(k.URL),
               CHARINDEX('http', RTRIM(k.URL)),
               CHARINDEX('''', RTRIM(k.URL) + '''', CHARINDEX('http', RTRIM(k.URL)))
                 - CHARINDEX('http', RTRIM(k.URL)))
        ELSE RTRIM(k.URL) END)) - 1)
             ELSE MAX(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('http', RTRIM(k.URL)) > 0
        THEN SUBSTRING(RTRIM(k.URL),
               CHARINDEX('http', RTRIM(k.URL)),
               CHARINDEX('''', RTRIM(k.URL) + '''', CHARINDEX('http', RTRIM(k.URL)))
                 - CHARINDEX('http', RTRIM(k.URL)))
        ELSE RTRIM(k.URL) END) END
      , 'https://', ''), 'http://', ''), 'www.', ''), 120) END                       AS Link_Name,
    LEFT(MAX(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('http', RTRIM(k.URL)) > 0
        THEN SUBSTRING(RTRIM(k.URL),
               CHARINDEX('http', RTRIM(k.URL)),
               CHARINDEX('''', RTRIM(k.URL) + '''', CHARINDEX('http', RTRIM(k.URL)))
                 - CHARINDEX('http', RTRIM(k.URL)))
        ELSE RTRIM(k.URL) END), 500)                   AS Link_URL,
    COUNT(*)                                     AS Clicks_Total,
    COUNT(DISTINCT k.SubscriberID)               AS Clicks_Unique,
    GETDATE()                                    AS LastRefresh
FROM _Click k
INNER JOIN _Job j ON j.JobID = k.JobID
INNER JOIN CRM_Reporte_Config c
        ON RTRIM(j.EmailName) = c.EmailName AND c.Activo = 'Si'
WHERE k.EventDate >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY c.ConfigKey, LEFT(RTRIM(k.URL), 500), LEFT(c.ConfigKey + '|' + RTRIM(k.URL), 400)

CRM_Email_Piezas_Load.name: CRM_Email_Piezas_Load
CRM_Email_Piezas_Load.queryText:
/*  CRM_Email_Piezas — mantenida por Hive
    Una fila por pieza del catalogo. Agrega TODOS los dias de CRM_Email_Detalle.
    Aqui viven Fecha_Primer_Envio y Fecha_Ultimo_Envio, que son de pieza, no de envio.
    Update type: Overwrite — se recalcula entera, es barata.                          */

SELECT
    d.ConfigKey                         AS ConfigKey,
    MAX(c.PiezaID)                      AS PiezaID,
    MAX(d.EmailName)           AS EmailName,
    MAX(d.Email_Subject)                AS Email_Subject,
    MAX(d.Email_ID)                     AS Email_ID,
    MAX(d.Audience_DE)                   AS Audience_DE,
    MAX(d.Audience_Volume)              AS Audience_Volume,
    MAX(d.Es_FUP)                       AS Es_FUP,
    MAX(d.Journey_ID_Datorama)          AS Journey_ID_Datorama,
    MAX(a.NPiezas)                      AS Piezas_Mismo_Asset,
    MAX(d.Codigo_NC)                    AS Codigo_NC,
    MAX(d.Journey_Name)                 AS Journey_Name,
    MAX(d.Journey_UUID)                 AS Journey_UUID,
    MAX(d.BU)                           AS BU,
    MAX(d.Marca)                        AS Marca,
    MAX(d.Campana)                      AS Campana,
    MAX(d.Touchpoint)                   AS Touchpoint,
    MAX(d.Segmento)                     AS Segmento,
    MIN(d.SendDay)                      AS Fecha_Primer_Envio,
    MAX(d.SendDay)                      AS Fecha_Ultimo_Envio,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.JobID)             AS N_Jobs,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.SendDay)           AS Dias_Con_Envio,
    SUM(d.Email_Sends)                  AS Email_Sends,
    SUM(d.Email_Deliveries)             AS Email_Deliveries,
    SUM(d.Email_Bounces)                AS Email_Bounces,
    SUM(d.Email_Unique_Opens)           AS Email_Unique_Opens,
    SUM(d.Email_Unique_Clicks)          AS Email_Unique_Clicks,
    SUM(d.Email_Total_Unsubs)          AS Email_Total_Unsubs,
    SUM(d.Email_Unique_Unsubs)          AS Email_Unique_Unsubs,
    CASE WHEN SUM(d.Email_Sends) = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE CONVERT(decimal(6,2), 100.0 * SUM(d.Email_Deliveries) / SUM(d.Email_Sends)) END AS Delivery_Rate,
    CASE WHEN SUM(d.Email_Deliveries) = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE CONVERT(decimal(6,2), 100.0 * SUM(d.Email_Unique_Opens) / SUM(d.Email_Deliveries)) END AS Open_Rate,
    CASE WHEN SUM(d.Email_Deliveries) = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE CONVERT(decimal(6,2), 100.0 * SUM(d.Email_Unique_Clicks) / SUM(d.Email_Deliveries)) END AS Click_Rate,
    CASE WHEN SUM(d.Email_Unique_Opens) = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE CONVERT(decimal(6,2), 100.0 * SUM(d.Email_Unique_Clicks) / SUM(d.Email_Unique_Opens)) END AS CTOR,
    CASE WHEN SUM(d.Email_Sends) = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE CONVERT(decimal(6,2), 100.0 * SUM(d.Email_Bounces) / SUM(d.Email_Sends)) END AS Bounce_Rate,
    GETDATE()                           AS LastRefresh
FROM CRM_Email_Detalle d
JOIN CRM_Reporte_Config c ON c.ConfigKey = d.ConfigKey
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT j.EmailID AS Asset, COUNT(DISTINCT c.ConfigKey) AS NPiezas
    FROM CRM_Reporte_Config c
    INNER JOIN _Job j ON RTRIM(j.EmailName) = c.EmailName
    WHERE c.Activo = 'Si'
    GROUP BY j.EmailID
) a ON a.Asset = d.Email_ID
GROUP BY d.ConfigKey

CRM_Reporte_Auditoria_Load.name: CRM_Reporte_Auditoria_Load
CRM_Reporte_Auditoria_Load.queryText:
/*  CRM_Reporte_Auditoria — mantenida por Hive
    Una fila por pieza del catalogo. LEFT JOIN a proposito: una pieza SIN datos tiene
    que salir con JobsEncontrados=0 y Estado='SIN MATCH'. Con INNER JOIN desapareceria,
    que es exactamente el falso negativo que esta tabla existe para evitar.
    DUPLICADO: dos piezas del catalogo con el MISMO ContentName. El dato se atribuye
    a una sola por la PK; la otra no es una falla, es un duplicado que hay que resolver
    en el catalogo. Sin este estado se veria igual que una pieza que de verdad falta.
    Su fila del dia es ademas el semaforo de que la corrida termino.                   */

SELECT
    c.ConfigKey                                  AS ConfigKey,
    c.PiezaID                                    AS PiezaID,
    c.EmailName                                AS EmailName,
    c.Campana                                    AS Campana,
    c.Marca                                      AS Marca,
    c.Activo                                     AS Activo,
    ISNULL(p.N_Jobs, 0)                          AS JobsEncontrados,
    ISNULL(p.Dias_Con_Envio, 0)                  AS DiasConEnvio,
    ISNULL(p.Email_Sends, 0)                     AS EnviosTotales,
    p.Fecha_Primer_Envio                         AS PrimerEnvio,
    p.Fecha_Ultimo_Envio                         AS UltimoEnvio,
    c.EmailID                                    AS Asset_Declarado,
    p.Email_ID                                   AS Asset_Real,
    ISNULL(p.Piezas_Mismo_Asset, 0)              AS Piezas_Mismo_Asset,
    CASE WHEN c.Activo <> 'Si'         THEN 'INACTIVO'
         WHEN ISNULL(p.N_Jobs, 0) = 0
              AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CRM_Email_Piezas p2
                          JOIN CRM_Reporte_Config c2 ON c2.ConfigKey = p2.ConfigKey
                          WHERE c2.EmailName = c.EmailName)
                                       THEN 'DUPLICADO'
         WHEN ISNULL(p.N_Jobs, 0) = 0  THEN 'SIN MATCH'
         WHEN c.EmailID IS NOT NULL AND p.Email_ID IS NOT NULL
              AND c.EmailID <> p.Email_ID
                                       THEN 'ASSET CAMBIO'
         WHEN ISNULL(p.Piezas_Mismo_Asset, 0) > 1
                                       THEN 'DUPLICADO'
         ELSE 'OK' END                           AS Estado,
    GETDATE()                                    AS LastRun
FROM CRM_Reporte_Config c
LEFT JOIN CRM_Email_Piezas p
       ON p.ConfigKey = c.ConfigKey

queriesOtras.name: CRM_Email_Performance_Load
queriesOtras.queryText:
/*  CRM_Email_Performance  —  mantenida por Hive
    Grano: 1 renglon por JobID. Metricas acumuladas a la fecha de refresco.
    Ventana movil: 90 dias.  Update type: Overwrite.  PK: JobID.

    ANCLA: el INNER JOIN contra 'sd' (envios dentro de la ventana) es lo que
    define que jobs entran. Sin el, un job enviado ANTES de la ventana pero con
    aperturas DENTRO entraba con Sent=0, y Delivered = 0 - Bounces salia
    NEGATIVO. Verificado: pasaba en 6 de 1213 filas.

    Por que las metricas se pre-agregan ANTES de unir con journey:
    _JourneyActivity puede traer mas de un renglon por actividad. Si se uniera
    primero, cada SUM se duplicaria. Aqui la subconsulta 'a' ya trae 1 renglon
    por JobID y afuera se usa MAX(), asi un fan-out no altera los numeros.

    SendDate: _Job.DeliveredTime viene NULL en muchos jobs (sobre todo triggered),
    por eso cae a la primera fecha de _Sent, que siempre existe si hubo envio.    */

SELECT
    a.JobID                                     AS JobID,
    MAX(j.EmailName)                            AS EmailName,
    MAX(j.EmailSubject)                         AS EmailSubject,
    MAX(ISNULL(j.DeliveredTime, sd.FirstSent))  AS SendDate,
    MAX(jr.JourneyName)                         AS JourneyName,
    MAX(jr.JourneyID)                           AS JourneyID,
    MAX(jr.VersionNumber)                       AS JourneyVersion,
    MAX(j.TriggererSendDefinitionObjectID)      AS TriggererSendDefID,
    MAX(a.Sent)                                 AS Sent,
    CASE WHEN MAX(a.Sent) - MAX(a.Bounces) < 0
         THEN 0 ELSE MAX(a.Sent) - MAX(a.Bounces) END
                                                AS Delivered,
    MAX(a.Bounces)                              AS Bounces,
    MAX(a.UniqueOpens)                          AS UniqueOpens,
    MAX(a.TotalOpens)                           AS TotalOpens,
    MAX(a.UniqueClicks)                         AS UniqueClicks,
    MAX(a.TotalClicks)                          AS TotalClicks,
    MAX(a.Unsubs)                               AS Unsubscribes,
    GETDATE()                                   AS LastRefresh
FROM (
    SELECT
        m.JobID              AS JobID,
        SUM(m.Sent)          AS Sent,
        SUM(m.Bounces)       AS Bounces,
        SUM(m.UniqueOpens)   AS UniqueOpens,
        SUM(m.TotalOpens)    AS TotalOpens,
        SUM(m.UniqueClicks)  AS UniqueClicks,
        SUM(m.TotalClicks)   AS TotalClicks,
        SUM(m.Unsubs)        AS Unsubs
    FROM (
            SELECT JobID, COUNT(*) AS Sent, 0 AS Bounces,
                   0 AS UniqueOpens, 0 AS TotalOpens,
                   0 AS UniqueClicks, 0 AS TotalClicks, 0 AS Unsubs
            FROM _Sent          WHERE EventDate >= DATEADD(day, -90, GETDATE()) GROUP BY JobID
        UNION ALL
            SELECT JobID, 0, COUNT(*), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
            FROM _Bounce        WHERE EventDate >= DATEADD(day, -90, GETDATE()) GROUP BY JobID
        UNION ALL
            SELECT JobID, 0, 0,
                   SUM(CASE WHEN IsUnique = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(*),
                   0, 0, 0
            FROM _Open          WHERE EventDate >= DATEADD(day, -90, GETDATE()) GROUP BY JobID
        UNION ALL
            SELECT JobID, 0, 0, 0, 0,
                   SUM(CASE WHEN IsUnique = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(*), 0
            FROM _Click         WHERE EventDate >= DATEADD(day, -90, GETDATE()) GROUP BY JobID
        UNION ALL
            SELECT JobID, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, COUNT(*)
            FROM _Unsubscribe   WHERE EventDate >= DATEADD(day, -90, GETDATE()) GROUP BY JobID
    ) m
    GROUP BY m.JobID
) a
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT JobID, MIN(EventDate) AS FirstSent
    FROM _Sent WHERE EventDate >= DATEADD(day, -90, GETDATE()) GROUP BY JobID
) sd     ON sd.JobID = a.JobID
INNER JOIN _Job j
        ON j.JobID = a.JobID
LEFT  JOIN _JourneyActivity ja
        ON ja.JourneyActivityObjectID = j.TriggererSendDefinitionObjectID
LEFT  JOIN _Journey jr
        ON jr.VersionID = ja.VersionID
GROUP BY a.JobID

queriesOtras.name: CRM_Nido_Yogu
queriesOtras.queryText:
SELECT SC.consumer_id ,
       SC.email_value ,
       SC.address_line_1 ,
       SC.address_line_2 ,
       SC.address_line_3 ,
       SC.address_line_4 ,
       SC.city ,
       SC.zipcode ,
       SC.region ,
       SC.country_code ,
       SC.title ,
       SC.first_name ,
       SC.last_name ,
       SC.additional_name_1 ,
       SC.additional_name_2 ,
       SC.salutation ,
       SC.marital_status ,
       SC.education ,
       SC.preferred_language_code ,
       SC.gender ,
       C.atopic_risk,
       C.feeding,
       C.is_woman_first_pregnancy,
       C.multiple_birth,
       SC.sfmc_entry_date ,
       SC.sfmc_app_last_update_date ,
       SC.consumer_type ,
       SC.birthdate_reliability ,
       SC.birthdate ,
       SC.market_code ,
       C.birthdate AS CHILD_BIRTHDATE ,
       C.birthdate_reliability AS CHILD_BIRTHDATE_RELIABILITY ,
       C.child_id ,
       C.first_name AS CHILD_FIRST_NAME ,
       C.gender AS CHILD_SEX ,
       DATEDIFF(DAY, c.birthdate, GETDATE()) AS CHILD_AGE_TOTAL_DAY,
       DATEDIFF(MONTH, c.birthdate, GETDATE()) AS CHILD_AGE_TOTAL_MONTH,
       DATEDIFF(DAY, c.birthdate, GETDATE()) / 7 AS CHILD_AGE_TOTAL_WEEKS,
       DATEDIFF(YEAR, c.birthdate, GETDATE()) AS CHILD_AGE_TOTAL_YEARS
FROM [ma_consumer] AS SC 
INNER JOIN [ma_child] AS C ON SC.consumer_id = C.consumer_id
INNER JOIN [ma_consumer_opt_in] AS OI ON SC.consumer_id = OI.consumer_id
WHERE OI.marketing_group_service_code IN ('MXinfantnut_Sbbbyadvml', 'MXinfantnut_SBmktemail')
AND (oi.REVOCATION_DATE IS NULL OR oi.ACCEPTANCE_DATE > oi.REVOCATION_DATE)
AND c.birthdate IS NOT NULL
AND c.birthdate >= DATEADD(MONTH, -36, GETDATE())
AND c.birthdate <= DATEADD(MONTH, -24, GETDATE())
